info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Materials-v5-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Materials Retrieval API provides access to a list of educational materials associated with student enrollments. This endpoint allows organizations to efficiently retrieve material details necessary for supporting educational programs. Typical consumers include educational institutions, enrollment coordinators, and administrators seeking to manage or distribute learning resources. By facilitating access to relevant materials, this API supports improved resource allocation and enhances the overall learning experience for students.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve materials associated with enrollments, providing necessary resources for students and administrators.
